title: Thanksgiving week: Dell, Best Buy & NVDA vol
card_lines: $DELL: options imply ~12-16% move on Nov 24 earnings
$BBY: ~10% implied move Nov 24; Telsey lifted PT to $110
$NVDA: IV rank fell 100 to ~59 after a 0.4x priced move
short: Weekly options watch: $DELL prices a ~12-16% earnings move (Nov 24), $BBY ~10% after a PT hike, $NVDA vol reset post-print. VIX ~24-25. https://analystledger.github.io #options #stocks
long:
Weekly options watch for Thanksgiving week: here is what the options market is pricing heading into a holiday-shortened week (closed Thu Nov 26, half-day Fri), with VIX hovering around 24-25 and the October PCE report due Wed Nov 25.

• $DELL — reports Tue Nov 24 after the close. Options imply a post-earnings move of roughly 12-16% depending on source, well above a typical large-cap print. Put open interest clusters near $300-310 and calls near $400, framing the range traders are watching.

• $BBY — reports Tue Nov 24 before the open with an implied move near ±9.6%. Telsey Advisory raised its price target to $110 (Outperform) this week, making it a read on holiday-season consumer demand.

• $NVDA — after pricing a ~7.7% earnings-day move, shares moved about 0.4x that amount and IV rank dropped from 100 to ~59. It also drew 14 analyst actions on our tracker this week, including six price-target cuts and two downgrades. Watch whether implied volatility keeps resetting lower.

Also on deck: $HPE (±14%), $WDAY, $ADSK, $HPQ and $DE.
